title: FUS and Tactile Neuromodulation in NHP VPL - Electrophysiology
description: This dataset contains intracranial electrophysiology recordings from the ventral posterolateral (VPL) thalamus of macaque monkeys, acquired using a NeuroNexus multi-channel probe on a Blackrock Cerebus system. Recordings were made during focused ultrasound (FUS) neuromodulation targeted at either VPL thalamus or insular cortex, and during tactile stimulation of the contralateral hand. The dataset supports investigation of how transcranial focused ultrasound modulates spiking and local field potential activity in the primate thalamus.
methods_description: Extracellular electrophysiology was recorded from VPL thalamus using a NeuroNexus V1x32-Edge single-shank probe (32 sites, 100 µm pitch, 177 µm² iridium sites) connected to a Blackrock CerePlex Direct system with a CerePlex M headstage. Spikes were sampled at 30 kHz and LFP at 1 kHz. Raw Blackrock files were read using NPMK (openNSx, openNEV) in MATLAB and converted to NWB format using MatNWB.
